name: shift
description: Multi-identity delegation skill — one agent that routes tasks to specialized sub-identities

source.note: Developed in the user's local OpenClaw workspace. Users can inspect source at that path before installing. No external repository.

install.inspectBeforeInstall: Before installing, inspect the skill source at ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/shift/ to verify behavior. All skill files are readable plaintext.
notes: Creates config.yaml from schema if not present
No network calls, no privilege escalation, no system modifications

calls: Model API calls to provider endpoints configured in OpenClaw config
All model providers configured by the user in their OpenClaw config
No external calls except model provider APIs
network.credentials: Uses OpenClaw's configured model provider credentials (reads from agent config). Does not store or declare its own credentials.

transmits: Conversation history (last N turns, configurable via contextBridge.historyTurns)
Active file references and partial file contents
MEMORY.md excerpts relevant to the current task
doesNotAccess: Other workspace files outside of session context
Environment variables or secrets not in workspace

modelProviders.note: This skill invokes whatever model providers the user configures in their persona settings. The skill does not ship with or declare specific provider credentials.
modelProviders.recommendation: Use trusted providers. Review your provider's data handling policy before delegating sensitive work.
